body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sharp is showcasing several revolutionary products and technologies that demonstrate the company's drive to innovate and improve the LCD industry with increased performance, the widest array of screen size offerings, improvements in energy efficiency and dazzling new designs.
(Picture: Daisuke Koshima, Chairman and CEO of Sharp)

While maintaining its commitment to the LCD industry, Sharp is also incorporating its leading display technologies into the video industry with new Blu-ray introductions and an array of powerful and stylish new audio products.
(Picture: Bob Scaglione, senior VP and group manager, Product and Marketing Group, Sharp)

"As a leading presence in the LCD industry, Sharp continues to dedicate considerable resources and steadfast commitment to improving and furthering LCD technology, giving consumers one-of-a-kind product enhancements that improve their lifestyles," said Bob Scaglione, senior vice president and group manager, Product and Marketing Group, Sharp Electronics Corporation. "As in years past, Sharp continues to show why we are an LCD leader. But we're also introducing several new products that complete the home theater experience, to give consumers both the highest image quality available and powerful cinema-like sound."
